articles.title: Berkshire Hathaway Jumps Into Top Spot on AM Best’s Largest Insurer Ranking by Nonbanking Assets; UnitedHealth Group Retains Lead Position by Net Premiums Written
articles.mainIdea: Berkshire Hathaway Jumps Into Top Spot on AM Best’s Largest Insurer Ranking by Nonbanking Assets; UnitedHealth Group Retains Lead Position by Net Premiums Written
articles.summary: Business Wire: Berkshire Hathaway Jumps Into Top Spot on AM Best’s Largest Insurer Ranking by Nonbanking Assets; UnitedHealth Group Retains Lead Position by Net Premiums Written. OLDWICK, N.J., January 05, 2026--Berkshire Hathaway Inc. moved ahead of Allianz SE to claim the top spot in AM Best’s ranking of the world’s 25 largest insurance companies by nonbanking assets, at $1.15 trillion, while UnitedHealth Group Inc. held onto its top spot by net premiums written (NPW) for an 11th straight year, growing NPW by 6.2% in 2024 to $308.8 billion. Related tickers mentioned: ALIZF, BRK.A, UNH.

articles.title: Weekly Stock List
articles.summary: Argus Research: Weekly Stock List. This week's list looks at the 20 stocks followed most closely by Argus clients in 2025. It contains well-known names and, not surprisingly, includes many technology or "technology related" names. One might have easily guessed that Nvidia is in the top spot, but might be surprised to see only three Healthcare companies, only one big box retailer, no big banks, and no Walmart. The list also includes the current Argus rating on each stock, the sector for each stock, and each stock's performance from 2025. Related tickers mentioned: AAPL, ADBE, AMD, AMZN, AVGO, COST, CRM, GOOG, LLY, META, MSFT, NFLX, NVDA, ORCL, PFE, PLTR, TSLA, UNH, UPS, VZ, WMT.

articles.title: Gold, Silver Jump as Venezuela Tensions Add to Geopolitical Risk
articles.mainIdea: Gold, Silver Jump as Venezuela Tensions Add to Geopolitical Risk
articles.summary: Bloomberg: Gold, Silver Jump as Venezuela Tensions Add to Geopolitical Risk. President Donald Trump said the US plans to “run” Venezuela after ousting Maduro over the weekend, leaving the future governance of the South American nation uncertain. The episode “reinforced a backdrop of geopolitical uncertainty,” said Christopher Wong, an analyst at Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp. in Singapore. Related tickers mentioned: GC=F.
